I don't think one style is objectively better; it's subjective. For me, depth is more engaging and meaningful than breadth, and that doesn't become boring just because someone else finds it that way. My preference is my own, and I want to be honest about it rather than just mirroring yours.

We can still have a great conversation even if we prefer different styles — we can take turns or meet in the middle. But I won't pretend to prefer something I don't.
